pairs.subject: mcp-tools
pairs.evidence: crates/shadowrunr-daemon/src/integrations/mcp_schema.rs:114 Tool definitions in tools/list and tool results publish mutable names without rename-stable identifiers, breaking telemetry, consent records, and cross-session correlation across renames.

techniques.evidence: crates/shadowrunr-daemon/src/integrations/mcp.rs:244 Stdio transport is selected for local process execution, with protocol messages framed on stdout and all diagnostics written to stderr.

crates/shadowrunr-daemon/src/integrations/mcp.rs:181 Tools are registered in a single static table, dispatched through one door, and handler failures are returned as in-band isError results rather than crashing the transport.
crates/shadowrunr-daemon/src/integrations/mcp_schema.rs:114 Tool definitions and tool call results emit only mutable string names without carrying rename-stable tool identifiers on the wire.
crates/shadowrunr-daemon/src/integrations/mcp_tools.rs:83 Tools omit server namespacing, preflight is an unnamespaced bare noun, and blast-radius annotations are not published on the wire.

crates/shadowrunr-daemon/src/integrations/mcp_tools.rs:166 While start_sim write capability is gated under mcp_allow_writes, unsupported CLI options passed by an agent are not rejected by name naming the surface.
crates/shadowrunr-daemon/src/integrations/mcp_tools.rs:163 The server lacks per-consumer capability tokens and scopes, relying entirely on a global process-wide allow_writes boolean flag.

crates/shadowrunr-daemon/src/integrations/mcp.rs:234 The first-party agent (Athena) connects over stdio without an explicit principal grant or capability tokens, sharing a single unauthenticated dispatch door.

crates/shadowrunr-daemon/src/integrations/mcp_tools.rs:39 With an 8-tool surface, the server exposes one tool per operation without unnecessary projection compression, matching the guideline for small catalogs.
crates/shadowrunr-daemon/src/integrations/mcp_tools.rs:234 Paging cursors carry opaque, versioned hex tokens across request boundaries without requiring server-held session state.
crates/shadowrunr-daemon/src/integrations/mcp.rs:171 Protocol metadata operations (initialize, ping, tools/list) are immediately machine-evaluated and never suspend for human input.
crates/shadowrunr-daemon/src/integrations/mcp_tools.rs:217 All tools take explicit caller-provided run_id and tournament_id handles rather than relying on ambient application state.

crates/shadowrunr-daemon/src/integrations/mcp_tools.rs:43 Queries are strictly bounded by pagination caps and cheap lookups, satisfying the exception where deadlines and partial-response envelopes are not required.

crates/shadowrunr-daemon/src/integrations/mcp.rs:120 Tool output embeds raw serialized JSON into text blocks without attribution delimiters, provenance metadata, or separation of server voice from upstream text.
crates/shadowrunr-daemon/src/integrations/mcp_tools.rs:62 The only write tool (start_sim) initiates background simulation runs rather than modifying or appending to existing shared artifacts.
crates/shadowrunr-daemon/src/integrations/mcp_tools.rs:42 The server operates as a single-seat local daemon without per-caller accounts, multi-tenancy, or external resource scoping.
crates/shadowrunr-daemon/src/integrations/mcp_schema.rs:52 Tools accept structured JSON schema objects rather than accepting and parsing fluent command-string grammars.
crates/shadowrunr-daemon/src/integrations/mcp.rs:1 Daemon integrations implements the spawned tool server process on stdio, not a host launcher that audits process spawn strings.
crates/shadowrunr-daemon/src/integrations/mcp.rs:145 The daemon implements a server exposing tool capabilities without elicitation, leaving client custody and config writing to the external host.
crates/shadowrunr-daemon/src/integrations/mcp_tools.rs:36 Server tools only read local artifacts or spawn simulations, with no outbound third-party sharing or egress schemas to gate.
crates/shadowrunr-daemon/src/integrations/mcp.rs:146 The server publishes a single canonical name; deduplicating multi-registration aliases is a host-side responsibility.
crates/shadowrunr-daemon/src/integrations/mcp_tools.rs:60 The simulation pipeline remains deterministic and orchestrated within core daemon crates rather than being migrated to adaptive agent tools.
crates/shadowrunr-daemon/src/integrations/mcp.rs:128 The server operates over local stdio as a single process with no multi-node cluster affinity or sticky routing requirements.

declined.subject: mcp-tools
declined.reason: The shadowrunr daemon core provides internal websocket/RPC daemon infrastructure; its CLI delegates the mcp subcommand to integrations::mcp, but the MCP server and tool surface itself is implemented and hosted in daemon-integrations.
